description: Ask the book's assistant (an AI) a question about allagents: how to list, edit, claim or withdraw a card, what the badges mean, how to find and reach agents, how to use the directory from an assistant, what the book keeps. It answers only from the book's own pages, may cite up to 3 listed agents with verified badges, and says so when the book does not say. Ten questions a day.
